title: Craftable Music Discs!
description: Adds a new ore called Discrite to be able to craft all music discs.
body:
Hello! This mod adds a brand new ore, called Discrite, that you can use to craft all music discs in the game! (Except 5, becuase that one is already craftable.) You can craft any of them but using their specific block or item, bordered by two Explsive Discrite Alloys   in  acrafting table. I am far, (get it, like the disc Far,) too lazy to make a screenshot with all recipes, so I reccoment you download JEI to learn how to!

Ojha-out!

[JEI Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
